source: docs/uk-station-fill/unassigned-england.md (UK station fill phase 2b, 14 Sep 2026), derived from the phase 2a candidate dataset (docs/uk-station-fill/source.md) already live-verified against Darwin 14 Sep 2026
notes: National Rail (Darwin/OpenLDBWS) is catalogued here — same shared uk-darwin.js provider as every other UK region, regionId rest-of-england. Registry status stays `planned` (docs/jim-brief-uk-station-fill-phase2b.md) until Mark/Tim's flip call.

This is an internal home for the 436 Darwin-verified English stations phase 2a's fifteen named regions did not claim (docs/uk-station-fill/unassigned-england.md) — not a geographic region a rider picks by name. The country-wide picker (docs/jim-brief-country-wide-station-picker.md) means riders search the whole country and never choose a region, so this is a home for the data, not something that needs to be found.

Single agency (National Rail), single mode (train). No hub lock, no corridor grouping — this is a flat catch-all allow-list spanning the whole of England, not a coherent metro/county area, so no single station is a structurally correct hub.

Nine stations that would otherwise belong here were held back instead: Altrincham, Eccles, Manchester Airport, Rochdale share a printed name with an existing greater-manchester Metrolink stop, and Brockley Whins, East Boldon, Heworth, Manors, Seaburn share a printed name with an existing north-east Tyne and Wear Metro stop, in both cases a name that is hardcoded in that region's own marketing-directions.js direction model. These nine are catalogued as mode: "train" entries in their own regions (greater-manchester, north-east) with an explicit doNotGroup pair against the same-name Metro/Metrolink stop instead — see lib/cities/greater-manchester/marketing-directions.js and lib/cities/north-east/marketing-directions.js DO_NOT_GROUP_PAIRS.

excludeOperators is not applied anywhere in this catalog — no station here was already flagged in docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md as a Caledonian Sleeper or Night Riviera calling point at the time of this pass; Crewe, Preston and Watford Junction (Caledonian Sleeper's English calling points) and any Night Riviera stop not already claimed by the Southwest pack are not in this dataset at all (checked against docs/uk-station-fill/unassigned-england.md's own 436-row list), so there is nothing to exclude here yet. Flagged for whoever next confirms a Sleeper calling point lands in this catalog.

CRS codes carry crsVerified: true and crsSource "live Darwin probe 2026-09-14" — these 436 stations were already live-verified against Darwin during UK station fill phase 2a (docs/jim-brief-uk-station-fill-phase2a.md); phase 2b catalogues them into this new region without re-probing.
Coordinates are carried from docs/uk-station-fill/unassigned-england.md's own lat/lng columns (sourced from the phase 2a candidate dataset, docs/uk-station-fill/source.md), not re-geocoded here.

70 stations reassigned out 15 Sep 2026 (docs/jim-brief-rest-of-england-reassignment.md, docs/uk-station-fill/assignment.md section 'Reassignment 15 Sep 2026'): each sat inside a real region's administrative territory (NaPTAN ATCO area / reverse geocoding, never CITY_BOUNDS boxes) that phase 2b's box-based sweep missed. 366 remain, genuinely unowned by any named region's territory (Warwickshire/Worcestershire/Staffordshire/Shropshire/Cheshire/Surrey/East Kent/Essex among them — reviewed and deliberately not claimed by any pack).
